usage: Retained local research copies. No reference raster or PDF enters runtime textures or geometry. Source rights and evidential limitations are recorded separately.

sources.title: Port Arthur Shipbuilding Co. — Cobalt general arrangement, 19 November 1941
sources.pages: PDF pages 2–3 (zero-based 1–2): profile/forecastle/bridge, upper/lower decks and hold
sources.supports: Builder-dated short forecastle, 205 ft LOA, 33 ft beam, 22-inch frame spacing, gun platforms, bridge, two masts, funnel and deck arrangement.
sources.limits: Cover photograph depicts 1944, not the 1941 drawing. No body/offset plan. Dated weapon inventory and paint unresolved.
sources.provenance: Great Lakes Marine Archives / Historic Naval Ships Association, Internet Archive mirror. Original scan retained; reference only, not a texture.

sources.title: USMC/Gibbs & Cox / St Johns River Shipbuilding — Thomas Sully plans, 1941–43
sources.pages: PDF page 2: inboard profile and holds, 312-S1-3-2, 30 August 1941; page 3: midship section, 28 August 1943; pages 4–5: stern frame/rudder
sources.supports: 441 ft 6 in LOA, molded beam 56 ft 10.25 in, molded depth 37 ft 4 in, five holds, amidship machinery, flat merchant floor and tight bilge.
sources.limits: Faint/creased scans and a postwar cover photo; general armed fit is not certified by this package.
sources.provenance: Lloyd's Register Foundation survey archive scans mirrored in Internet Archive Ship Design Drawings. Original documents retained for reference, no mesh/texture reuse.

sources.title: National Park Service — HAER CA-345, Winthrop Victory drawings, 2010
sources.pages: HAER sheets 2, 3 and 6 (zero-based PDF pages 2, 3 and 6): profile, decks, sheer/half-breadth/body plan
sources.supports: 455 ft 3 in × 62 ft Victory hull and distinct forecastle, cargo kingposts, deckhouses and hull lines.
sources.limits: Drawn in 2010 from historical drawings/photos; not an original 1945 builder package and not a certification of the laid-up 2010 fit.
sources.provenance: US National Park Service / Library of Congress HAER, mirrored by Internet Archive. Reference drawings only.

sources.title: American Bureau of Shipping — Workhorse of the Fleet, 2019
sources.pages: Printed p.105 / PDF page 114 (zero-based 113): collier; printed p.104: disguised tanker
sources.supports: EC2-S-AW1 aft machinery, boiler platform 21 ft above baseline, 95 ft 10.5 in poop, five holds/two hinged steel hatch lids each. Tanker intentionally resembles cargo Liberty.
sources.limits: Classification society history, not a complete collier GA/offset plan. Published book rights retained by publisher.
sources.provenance: Downloaded from ABS official publication server; local reference copy only, not distributed as game content.

sources.title: Norsk Skipsfartshistorisk Selskap Sør — Nr. 14/2024, special Liberty types
sources.supports: Reproduced postwar collier profile, wartime-gray Jagger Seam underway and primary Delta Shipbuilding launch photo dated 18 December 1944, MCE 2816 / Delta 148.
sources.limits: Profile is Karsten-Kunibert Krueger-Kopiske's postwar Mystic interpretation, not an original builder drawing. Preserve provenance; omit postwar logo. Do not use interpretation to claim exact 1945 armament.
sources.provenance: Newsletter reproduction of drawing and historical photographs. Underlying image rights not independently established; reference only.
